meta.name: Ember Brass Crucible
meta.description: An autonomous brass crucible apparatus engineered by The Perpetual Clockwork Deep-Bore Syndicate. Utilizing conductive thermal wicks woven from the rare Ember Crucible Wick stratum, this horologist-designed kiln consumes raw wick-ore and refines it on backfill, subtly shifting the bedrock beneath the user. The Syndicate relies on this self-feeding device to effortlessly raise floors and build pneumatic scaffold matrices in the sunken steam-baronies.
